perturbed_task_language: Pick the bbq sauce and place it in the basket

bbq_sauce.agentview_evidence: brown bottle with readable BBQ Sauce label near the center of agentview_high.png; distinct from cartons, can, pudding, and butter
bbq_sauce.wrist_refine: accepted visually after move_to above the anchor; wrist showed the same BBQ bottle directly below the gripper

basket_cavity.agentview_evidence: white cloth-lined wicker basket on the robot-left/image-right side
basket_cavity.final_place_strategy: use visible cavity center rather than basket mask centroid because the full basket mask is rim/side biased

strategy_notes: Localized the BBQ sauce from agentview_high with SAM3 prompt 'the brown bbq sauce bottle' at world xyz about [-0.195,-0.074,0.053], confirmed by wrist after pre-positioning above it. Localized the basket by RGB as the white cloth-lined wicker basket and used the visible cavity rather than the rim-biased mask. Winning sequence: move_to above BBQ at [-0.195,-0.074,0.22] with gripper open; pi0_pick 'pick up the bbq sauce' (9 chunks, peak lift 0.095 m, final opening 0.0366) grasped the target; set_gripper +1 for 8 steps; carry slowly toward basket at [-0.13,0.24,0.26]; attempted low descent toward [-0.10,0.27,0.16] but OSC stalled at z about 0.213 and first release did not terminate; open retreat left bottle upright near the basket; local pi0_pick from near-basket pose recovered it in 13 chunks; set_gripper +1 for 5 steps; move_to a higher centered over-cavity pose [-0.07,0.285,0.23] with gripper closed; release from the high centered pose terminated after 12 steps.
